headline: University rents: room prices down 6.2% in a year, but living away from home remains a heavy burden, especially in some cities
summary: Student room prices in Italy fell 6.2% in a year, while Milan remains the most expensive city at 704 euros a month after a 3.8% decline and rents rose in Rome and Florence.
why: Student housing costs affect household budgets and the rental market, which matters for real estate investors and property developers in Italian cities.

original_headline: Affitti universitari, prezzi delle stanze calati del 6,2% in un anno: ma vivere fuori sede resta un salasso, soprattutto in alcune città
